column2: Layers from the bottom: `sc-agent-types`; `sc-agent-config`, `sc-agent-secrets` and `sc-agent-log`; `sc-agent-http`; `sc-decision-schema`; the decision backends `sc-decision-systemone`, `sc-decision-local` and `sc-decision-llm` (over `sc-llm-provider`); `sc-decision-runner`, which handles decision models only.
column3: No sc-agent crate's Cargo.toml must depend on a crate in a higher layer, where the layers from the bottom are: types; config, secrets and log; http; decision schema; decision backends; runner.

column5: adds or changes a crate dependency in a Cargo.toml

column2: An error MUST carry the error id and message of every lower-layer error that caused it.
column3: Every error returned by a public sc-agent function must carry the id and message of each lower-layer error that caused it.
column4: Each crate returns its own error union carrying lower errors
column5: adds or changes an error type or a public function's return type

column2: `sc-agent-types` and `sc-decision-schema` MUST NOT contain types specific to plan-anchor, judge-jev or any other consumer application.

column4: No consumer-app or Jev-mock types in shared crates
column5: adds or changes a type in sc-agent-types or sc-decision-schema

column2: A program that does not use tokio MUST be able to use every low-level crate.

column4: Low-level crates build and run without tokio
column5: adds or changes dependencies of a low-level sc-agent crate

column2: sc-agent source code MUST NOT call `std::thread::sleep`, `std::thread::sleep_until`, `tokio::time::sleep` or any other sleep function.
column3: sc-agent source code must not call std::thread::sleep, tokio::time::sleep or any other sleep function.

column2: Every type that maps to the Jev API MUST be defined in `sc-decision-schema`.

column4: Jev API types defined only in sc-decision-schema, built from the spec

column2: A request that receives a busy response MUST be resent unchanged.
column3: A request that receives an HTTP 429, 502 or 529 response must be resent until a configurable maximum number of sends, 5 by default, is reached.
column4: Busy resend: configurable sends, holdoff in the queue
column5: adds or changes busy-response handling, resend, holdoff or the runner queue

column2: `sc-decision-runner` MUST run the requests of one batch in parallel across workers.
column3: sc-decision-runner must send the requests of one batch in parallel across a configurable number of worker threads, 8 by default.
column4: Batches run in parallel, fastest first, failures returned
